description: External SQL corpus sources used to diversify Phase 1 convergence evidence beyond textbook questions and local handcrafted attacks.

sources.name: WikiSQL official archive
sources.license_note: Use according to the upstream WikiSQL repository terms.
sources.bias_risk: Single-table benchmark distribution; useful for projection, aggregation and simple predicates but insufficient for joins, nesting, windows and dialect edges.

sources.name: Spider text-to-SQL benchmark
sources.license_note: Download and use according to the upstream Spider terms.
sources.bias_risk: Academic benchmark distribution; strong for cross-domain schemas but still benchmark-shaped rather than production query logs.

sources.name: BIRD text-to-SQL benchmark
sources.license_note: Download and use according to the upstream BIRD terms.
sources.bias_risk: Large real-database benchmark, useful for schema realism; availability and redistribution are controlled upstream.

sources.name: SQLancer targeted DBMS testing reference
sources.license_note: Use according to the upstream SQLancer repository terms.
sources.bias_risk: Not a text-to-SQL corpus; use as a source of oracle and metamorphic attack tactics rather than as raw educational questions.
